parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/application/dto module has one job: defining the data shapes that cross the application boundary, plus the mappers from domain entities to those shapes. All three files follow the same pattern. Each has input interfaces for its use cases, an output DTO interface, and a pure mapper function (toXDto) from its domain entity. No file mixes in other concerns such as validation, persistence or business logic. No invariant is duplicated: each mapper serializes only its own entity, and the only real conversion (dueDate Date to ISO string or null) lives in toTaskDto alone. ProjectDto and UserDto have the same {id, name} shape, but that is a structural coincidence between separate entities, not a duplicated rule. Status is typed as a plain string in the inputs, so no domain rule is copied here. No file works around the module's pattern. The incoming edges show each use case importing only its matching DTO file, which keeps the boundary consistent.
